name: Sample: mass properties
author: Madhav Baliga
description: A plugin with two analyses. Mass and centre of mass from the mesh and each body's material (validated against analytic cases), and a voxel density section (experimental, to show how experimental results are treated).

analyses.label: Mass and centre of mass
analyses.description: Volume by the divergence theorem over the closed surface mesh, mass from each body's material density, centre of mass from the tetrahedron centroids.

analyses.label: Density section (voxel)
analyses.description: Fills each body into a voxel grid and stores its material density per voxel. Demonstrates a voxel field and slice overlay. Marked experimental on purpose.

checks.label: Max density ≤ limit (demo of an experimental check)
